key: One notification per version. Open it to see what changed and update when you're ready.
source: One notification per version. Open it to see what changed and update when you're ready.
translation: Una notificación por versión. Ábrela para ver qué ha cambiado y actualiza cuando quieras.

key: If a session stops without finishing, Belay now says so instead of making it look complete.
source: If a session stops without finishing, Belay now says so instead of making it look complete.
translation: Si una sesión se detiene sin terminar, Belay ahora lo dice en vez de hacer que parezca completa.

key: A handful of interface improvements, mostly in places you already use.
source: A handful of interface improvements, mostly in places you already use.
translation: Unas cuantas mejoras en la interfaz, sobre todo en sitios que ya usas.
Guardar informes de errores en local

key: Writes crashes, freezes and errors to a file on this Mac. Nothing is sent anywhere, and nothing is collected while this is off.
source: Writes crashes, freezes and errors to a file on this Mac. Nothing is sent anywhere, and nothing is collected while this is off.
translation: Escribe fallos, bloqueos y errores en un archivo de este Mac. No se envía nada a ningún sitio, y mientras esto esté desactivado no se recoge nada.

key: Writes crashes, freezes and errors to a file on this Mac. Nothing is sent anywhere, ever. If something goes wrong, opening an issue and attaching this file is what turns it into a fix. Sharing it is your decision, every time.
source: Writes crashes, freezes and errors to a file on this Mac. Nothing is sent anywhere, ever. If something goes wrong, opening an issue and attaching this file is what turns it into a fix. Sharing it is your decision, every time.
translation: Escribe fallos, bloqueos y errores en un archivo de este Mac. Nunca se envía nada. Si algo va mal, abrir una incidencia y adjuntar este archivo es lo que lo convierte en un arreglo. Compartirlo lo decides tú, cada vez.

key: Keep crash reports on this Mac
source: Keep crash reports on this Mac
translation: Guardar informes de errores en este Mac

key: Belay saves crash, freeze, and error reports locally. Nothing is sent automatically. You decide what to share when reporting a problem.
source: Belay saves crash, freeze, and error reports locally. Nothing is sent automatically. You decide what to share when reporting a problem.
translation: Belay guarda los informes de fallos, bloqueos y errores en local. No se envía nada automáticamente. Tú decides qué compartir al informar de un problema.
